paragraphs.text:
If you were successful in combat, your attacker falls heavily to 
the floor. Otherwise, your cat-like grace means you have evaded 
him and run away. You spend the night unmolested in the hotel. 
In the morning you decide to head for Cairo, go to 195.
(222)
